locked_attributes.identity: Adult Chinese male; angular oval face matching the selected animated master.
locked_attributes.hair: Short spiky black hair, tapered sides, stable hairline and silhouette.
locked_attributes.eyes: Natural adult-sized eyes; normal blinking and gaze changes are allowed.
locked_attributes.glasses: Dark thick rectangular frames with clear lenses; stable bridge and temples.
locked_attributes.top: Plain coral-pink crewneck sweatshirt, no hood, no added chest emblem.
locked_attributes.footwear: Customized black high-top sneakers, cream midsoles, black outsoles, blue side accents and red-pink toe details.
locked_attributes.rendering: Mature clean 2D anime ink with restrained 1-2 level cel shading.
locked_attributes.proportions: Natural adult proportions, approximately 7-7.5 heads tall; compare silhouettes visually.

watch.candidate_choice: dark watch on the character's left wrist
watch.rule: Choose once per version/continuous scene; do not swap wrists or pop in and out.

shoe_lettering.rule: Verify anatomical left/right against original shoe photos before a lettering close-up; do not infer from screen-left.

reference_policy.portrait: Identity origin only; consult when establishing or revising the animated design.
reference_policy.legacy_character_sheet: Inherited design source, not a single-subject video frame.
reference_policy.shoe_photos: Shoe detail only; never transfer background or photographic rendering.
reference_policy.expression_and_pose_sheets: Performance only; cannot redefine geometry or outfit.
reference_policy.candidate_masters: Review and draft generation only until actually selected.

approval_policy.notes: Record the user's actual selection or documented approval. Do not fabricate approval from script validation.
